tagline: Zeiss Ikon取景器相机，1960 年发布
description: Zeiss Ikon于1960年推出的取景器相机。配备Novar 45mm f/3.5。快门速度Pronto, 1/30–1/250 +B with self-timer and flash sync for bulbs (at 1/30) + electronic (at all speeds)。

specs.快门: Pronto, 1/30–1/250 +B with self-timer and flash sync for bulbs (at 1/30) + electronic (at all speeds)
specs.英文简介:
The Colora is a 35mm viewfinder camera made in Germany by Zeiss Ikon, taking 24×36mm frames "on usual cartridges".Page from Zeiss' 1961 catalogue, formerly shown on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20160307004929/http://www.marriottcameras.co.uk/ Marriott site (archived)]

=== 1960 model===

The first model was introduced in c.1960; p.1040.
